headline: Plans for 675 Andover Street withdrawn; 585 Protected Boulevard car wash moved to December 7.
summary: The applicant withdrew its requests for 675 Andover Street, and the car wash review at 585 Protected Boulevard was continued to December 7. The board also heard a site plan for a 205-unit mixed-use building at 41 Third Street, and a motion to approve it with conditions was made. The transcript does not record how that vote ended.
decisions: Withdrawal without prejudice of the special permit requests for 675 Andover Street, by a vote of four in favor, none against, and one abstaining.
Continued to December 7 the review of a car wash at 585 Protected Boulevard.
discussion: 41 Third Street site plan: Members discussed the 36 parking spaces, a plan to lease spaces in the Lower Locks garage, trash pickup, snow removal, bike storage, and replacing street trees. Members spoke in favor of the design and its amenities.
Market-rate housing: Members said the project would add market-rate housing that downtown needs and could help downtown businesses.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion to allow the withdrawal. Okay motion to allow withdrawal without prejudice. Okay by attorney Tenzin. Second. Vice Chair Fischet. All in favor say aye. Aye. Chair votes yes. Allowed to withdraw without prejudice. In the opposition hearing none the motion carries four in favor none against and one abstain.

Mr. Chairman, I'll make a motion to approve the request to continue to the December 7th planning board meeting. Second the motion. All those in favor say aye. Aye. ... so anybody who's watching tonight, I'm out of there on the conductor's bill, we'll be continuing until December 7th, and there'll be no further advertisement for that matter.
